definitions.full: H4966. mathoq or mathuq מָתוֺק adjective sweet , and noun [masculine] sweetness (on form see Lag BN 30, 60 , compare Ba NB 13, 36 ); — absolute ׳מ Judg 14:14 9 t.; feminine מְתוּקָה Eccl 5:11 ; plural מְתוּקִים Psa 19:11 ; — 1 sweet , of honey Judg 14:14 (where ׳מ = substantive a sweet thing ), 14:18 (both Samson's riddle), Prov 24:13 ; so = sweetness , Ezek 3:3 ; more Generally, מ ׳כָּלמַֿר Prov 27:7 every bitter thing is sweet to one hungry; figurative Psa 19:11 (God's commandments, sweeter than honey), compare Prov 16:24 (simile of pleasant words) מ ׳וּפִרְיוֺ לְחִכִּי Song 2:3 (i.e his caresses); לְמ מַר ׳שָׂמִים ׳וּמ לְמָ֑ר Isa 5:20 making bitter into sweet and sweet into bitter (obscuring moral distinctions; || רָ֑ע וְלַטּוֺב טוֺב לָרַע הָאֹמְרִים ). 2 = pleasant , sleep of the toiler Eccl 5:11 ; light 1:17 (|| אֶתהַֿשֶּׁמֶשׁ לִרְאוֺת לַעֵינַיִם טוֺב ).
